title: Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
body:
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
Ab aglay baras hind may aap aayengay Aaqa
Jeetay rahey khaadim tho tumhey paaengayAaqa
Kuch sharth ghulaami ki bajaa laaengay Aaqa
Aye shiyoun ke mehmaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya taaziya khaanou may barasthi hai udaasi
Main tumpey fida aaj woh raunaq nahin kalki
Aawaaz yeh hai har dar-o-diwaar sey aathi
Aye deen ke sultaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye jaan-o-dil-e-Ahmad-e-Mukhtaar sidhaaro
Aye beykason ke qaafila salaar sidhaaro
Khaaliq ki amaan aye Shahey Abrar sidhaaro
Allah nigehbaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey Qasim waaye Akbar-e-jarraar sidhaaro
Aey Hazrat Abbas-e-Alamdaar sidhaaro
Aey ghunchadahan bano ke dildaar sidhaaro
Aey Asghar-e-nadaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kaahey ko tashreef yahaan layegi Zehra
Ab kaahey ko yaan bazm-e-aza hoyegi barpaa
Ab kaahey ko yaan hoga azadaroun ka aana
Ghar hogaya sunsaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
<<DIVIDER>>
Ronay hi na paaye tujhey aye kushta-e-aada
Kya jald huva khatm teray gham ka zamaana
Dasveen hai Moharram ki bas ab ho chuka ashra
Baqir teray qurbaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
<<MINI>>
Aye Sarware Zeeshaan Khuda hafiz-o-Naser
Aye Fatima ki Jaan Khuda hqfiz-o-Naser
